description: This source file implements PWM signal generation logic, including classes and functions for configuring PWM, setting duty cycles, handling signal toggling, and managing hardware pin states within a firmware project.

classes.name: SimplePwm
classes.description: Class managing simple PWM signal with duty cycle and frequency control.

classes.name: PwmConfig
classes.description: Class representing PWM configuration, including multiple waveforms and callback handling.

methods.name: setSimplePwmDutyCycle
methods.description: Adjusts the duty cycle of the PWM signal dynamically.

methods.name: handleCycleStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a PWM cycle, resetting internal state if needed.

methods.name: togglePwmState
methods.description: Calculates and returns the next timestamp for toggling the PWM signal.

methods.name: weComplexInit
methods.description: Initializes PWM with complex waveform parameters and starts the PWM cycle.

methods.name: copyPwmParameters
methods.description: Copies PWM parameters into internal structures for operation.

methods.name: startSimplePwm
methods.description: Starts a simple PWM signal with specified frequency and duty cycle.

methods.name: startSimplePwmExt
methods.description: Extends starting PWM with additional pin initialization.

methods.name: applyPinState
methods.description: Sets hardware pin states according to PWM configuration.
